arc.statement: A monocular camera, one that the field assumed needed a depth sensor beside it, builds a hierarchical metric-semantic 3D scene graph in real time. The next question is what a robot does with that structure when it has to decide where to look next.

actOne.title: Understanding space
actOne.line: Building metric-semantic hierarchical 3D scene graphs from a single camera and an IMU, in real time.

actTwo.title: Learning to explore
actTwo.line: Turning that representation into action: a deterministic planner proposes only certified routes, and a learned model chooses among them.
actTwo.honesty: The formulation and the layering contract are written up. The experiments are not run yet, so there are no results to report.

arc.prologue: The same question was asked at Peradeniya in 2016 and 2017, with a laser range finder fused with stereo cameras. It is being asked again 10 years later with a learned model and a single camera.
